objective: Prevent same-trajectory AUTO_CONTINUE from monopolizing System focus by requiring a fresh strategic opportunity refresh before every autonomous continuation, while preserving low-friction deterministic continuation when no materially better cross-domain move exists.

roles_before.role: Permit one deterministic same-trajectory continuation after verified completion without redundant user ceremony.
Fail closed on conflicts, multiple candidates, unsafe candidates, material choices, stale sources, duplicates, or external writes.
Choose the best real-world next move across domains while keeping current facts, obligations, and strategic context authoritative.
Autonomous continuation cannot authorize external live-source writes.
Only verified completion/evidence may trigger deterministic follow-through.
Executable regression coverage for continuation gate behavior.

capability_probes.assertion: A single safe same-trajectory candidate still AUTO_CONTINUEs after a fresh strategic refresh confirms no materially better cross-domain opportunity.
A same-trajectory candidate must not AUTO_CONTINUE when strategic refresh is missing/stale or identifies a materially better cross-domain opportunity.
Evidence resolution and external-write boundaries remain unchanged; missing/reported evidence still cannot resolve or reward a quest.

tests.expected: AUTO_CONTINUE requires strategic_refresh_status=PASS and no materially better cross-domain opportunity; missing/failed refresh returns ASK_RON.
Verified evidence resolution and safe same-trajectory continuation semantics continue to pass.
System routing, strategic-context, evidence-followthrough and external mutation boundaries remain intact.
